Wearing: Mid-grey herringbone tweed lounge suit, waistcoat with silver watch chain, white shirt with starched collar, dark green knitted tie, brown lace-up boots. Straw boater with a black band. Ash-grey hair parted on the left, ash-grey moustache, faint pink scar on the left temple. Black notebook in the breast pocket.

shot.frame: Wide from the road at a dog cart standing at a white gate in the red evening with a horse in the shafts and two women already up in it, a bundle tied in a tablecloth and a corded box on the tail of it, and the whole crest of the hill behind the house going up in thick streamers of black smoke shot through with threads of red fire.
shot.at_rest: The scorched lawn fills the BOTTOM half of the frame from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge with broken red chimney brick scattered on it at the BOTTOM CENTRE and the BOTTOM RIGHT. The summerhouse stands at the LEFT third, the low brick garden wall runs across the CENTRE from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge with the white gate in it at the CENTRE RIGHT, the broken roof line and the burning church tower stand above the wall at the CENTRE, and thick black smoke fills the TOP third from the CENTRE to the RIGHT edge.

setup.described: the same walled lawn on the crest of Maybury Hill with the valley below it on fire: the broken roof line of the Oriental College and a half-fallen church tower burning above the garden wall, thick black smoke driving up off them across the whole sky, a wooden summerhouse and a white gate on the near lawn, and broken red chimney brick scattered fresh on the grass; the light is the fire itself, low and raking from beyond the wall, so the lawn reads scorched orange, the summerhouse and the gate read hot red on their fire side and black on the other

shot.frame: Close on the dismounted hussar (brown curly hair cropped close to the skull, clean-shaven boyish jaw, dark rifle-green serge hussar jacket with yellow cord frogging, right sleeve torn and blackened with soot) stopped in the road in the red evening with his head turned back over his shoulder and his mouth open, shouting, the soot black across one cheek, and a whirl of black smoke already driving across the road behind him.
shot.at_rest: His head fills the CENTRE of the frame from the TOP third to the BOTTOM third, turned back over his shoulder at the CENTRE LEFT. A whirl of black smoke fills the RIGHT third and the TOP edge behind him, and red firelight stands along the LEFT edge. His head is half the frame's height.

physical: Trooper of the 8th Hussars, 22 years old, 5 ft 8 in, lean horseman's build with long thighs, narrow hips and slightly bowed legs. Oval face, olive-tanned skin, straight nose. Brown curly hair cropped close to the skull. Clean-shaven boyish jaw. Dark brown eyes. A thin pale scar across the left eyebrow. Wearing: Dark green pillbox forage cap with yellow band on a chin strap, dark rifle-green serge hussar jacket with yellow cord frogging and yellow-edged collar, right sleeve torn and blackened with soot, dark green overalls with double yellow stripes mud-caked to the knee, black riding boots, steel spurs, cavalry sword on slings
